t: I built a website for a dentist,
but the task wasn't just
to make a pretty website.
She's a doctor who works with patients,
trains doctors, runs internships, mentoring.
She has so many products
a student may not get what fits them.
So we built more than a website.
We mapped the whole user journey.
For example, we added a quiz:
a student answers just three questions:
what's their level,
what they want to get
and which field interests them.
And the site suggests the right format.
It's convenient and a bit of gamification.
We built the site so people instantly see
who this doctor is, why to trust her,
what she offers and what to do next.
We built it all in a very short time,
a good site isn't just a pretty design,
it's a tool that solves the doctor's task.
Comment «врач»,
and I'll pick one doctor for a free review.
